name: video-pause
description: A video camera with two solid pause bars.
useCase: Pause a video capture or camera preview.
misuse: Name the control for the video action it performs; do not rely on color alone to indicate recording.

16.reason: The complete camera body and lens surround a separate solid control mark inside the shared square frame.

24.reason: Both complete pause bars align with the other control marks inside the unchanged camera outline.
